metadata.title: Invoice-to-Cash Outcome Streams
metadata.description: Eight proposed outcomes linking payer and creditor jobs to accountable delivery.
metadata.flowModelNote: Flows describe doing the work; customer journey stories separately describe adoption.

steps.title: Validate source and recipient
keyFacts: Design requirement: Reject duplicates, stale invoice versions and unresolved recipient mappings before dispatch.
painPoints: Source amounts and contacts may disagree.

dependencies.name: Receivable Intake and Version Control
dependencies.description: Creditor invoice references, approved amounts, due dates, source versions and correction history. Owns the imported operational projection; the creditor ERP remains authoritative for legal invoices.
dependencies.how: Validate source and recipient uses Validated Receivable API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Creditor Connectors and Onboarding Acceptance
dependencies.description: Versioned source-to-domain mappings, rejected-record reasons, compatibility scenarios and cutover acceptance. Owns mappings, not the external creditor's records.
dependencies.how: Validate source and recipient uses Connector Contract API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Creditor Configuration and Entitlements
dependencies.description: Creditor entities, enabled products, approved domains, provider-connection references and versioned configuration. Secrets are represented only by protected references.
dependencies.how: Validate source and recipient uses Creditor Configuration API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

steps.title: Approve recognizable content
keyFacts: Design requirement: Use the current creditor-approved template, language and payment reference.
painPoints: A visually familiar message can still contain a wrong balance.

dependencies.name: Creditor Templates and Accessible Content
dependencies.description: Versioned creditor identity, language variants, approved text and accessibility review records; prevents an unapproved bulk message version from being released.
dependencies.how: Approve recognizable content uses Template Preview and Approval API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Recipient Contact Preferences
dependencies.description: Purpose-specific contact routes, language, accessibility needs and verified contact corrections. A preference is not automatically a legal consent or a reliable identity signal.
dependencies.how: Approve recognizable content uses Contact Policy API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Payment Request and QR Lifecycle
dependencies.description: Purpose-limited tokens bound to creditor, invoice version and current amount, with expiry and consumed or superseded state. No bank credentials are stored.
dependencies.how: Approve recognizable content uses Payment Request API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

steps.title: Dispatch with current eligibility
keyFacts: Design requirement: Recheck current balance and case holds immediately before sending and retain the provider reference.
painPoints: A payment or dispute may arrive between scheduling and send.

dependencies.name: Multichannel Dispatch and Delivery Recovery
dependencies.description: Approved message versions, provider request references, transport outcomes and fallback decisions. Dispatch rechecks current balance and holds; transport receipt does not establish reading.
dependencies.how: Dispatch with current eligibility uses Controlled Dispatch API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Case, Dispute and Hold Management
dependencies.description: Case chronology, minimal dispute context, promises, holds, accountable next actions and approved agency handoffs. Distinguishes pending evidence from a final liability decision.
dependencies.how: Dispatch with current eligibility uses Case and Hold API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

steps.title: Choose an allowed next action
keyFacts: Design requirement: Evaluate current policy and contact restrictions; recommendations cannot override a hold.

dependencies.description: Versioned contact policies, due actions, send eligibility and suppression decisions. Final execution checks latest payment, dispute, support and frequency conditions before dispatch.
dependencies.how: Choose an allowed next action uses Collection Policy API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Contact Recommendation and Explanation
dependencies.description: Versioned time, channel and tone recommendations with input provenance, eligibility, explanation and overrides. Recommends only within approved policy; no autonomous adverse action.
dependencies.how: Choose an allowed next action uses Contact Recommendation API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Recipient Contact Preferences
dependencies.description: Purpose-specific contact routes, language, accessibility needs and verified contact corrections. A preference is not automatically a legal consent or a reliable identity signal.
dependencies.how: Choose an allowed next action uses Contact Policy API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

steps.title: Execute contact or human support
keyFacts: Design requirement: Recheck eligibility before dispatch and provide a clear route to dispute or arrangement.

dependencies.description: Evidence-backed allocation between external confirmed receipts and imported obligations, including confidence, residual amounts and authorized corrections. This is not a bank or general ledger.

dependencies.description: Derived cash, plan, complaint and service-cost cohorts with denominator definitions and source lineage. Holds remain visible and arrangements are never labeled cash.
dependencies.how: Verify resolution or authorize transfer uses Outcome Cohort API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.

dependencies.name: Decision and Access Audit Evidence
dependencies.description: Actor, purpose, tenant, policy version, material decision and correlation references sufficient to reconstruct actions. Excludes raw payment credentials and unnecessary case payloads.
dependencies.how: Verify resolution or authorize transfer uses Scoped Audit Evidence API with authorized context and recorded outcomes.
